_doc: Curated technique seeds (knowledge_architecture.md section 5), one file per area. Fields: id, level + scope (a scope node or universal), aliases (v1 / technique-DB / footer names folded in), mechanism, preconditions (predicate DSL), predicts (canonical metric -> up|down|flat|up_or_flat|down_or_flat), risks (pitfalls), states / op_classes / op_kinds gates (empty = any), slot (offered by the multi-slot agent), prior {mean, n}: a seed prior with a low pseudo-count that evidence overrides, realizations by scope (target:<key> | target:<backend>:sm_NN+ | target:<backend> | node:<id> | universal). Loaded by Ontology.seed(); scripts/seed_knowledge.py builds a knowledge.db from these files.

techniques.mechanism: depthwise convs have no cross-channel reuse: tile H x W per channel with a halo in on-chip memory and compute several outputs per thread
risks: implicit GEMM is the wrong lever here (K = KH*KW is tiny)

realizations.how: One block per (n, c, spatial tile): load the input tile + (KH-1, KW-1) halo once into on-chip memory, each thread computes a strip of outputs along W, filter taps in registers.
Vectorise along W with the KHxKW taps unrolled as vfmacc.vf on shifted loads.

techniques.mechanism: compute a transposed conv as a gather over the input taps that hit each output, not as a scatter with atomics
risks: zero taps when stride > 1 (skip them by parity)

realizations.how: One thread per output element: loop only over the kernel taps with (o + pad - k) % stride == 0 (split by output parity into stride^2 dense sub-convolutions); no atomics.

techniques.mechanism: tile D x H x W output blocks and stage the input slab (+halo) once, then reuse it across output channels
risks: on-chip memory for a 3D halo grows fast; keep D-tiles shallow

realizations.how: Block over (oc tile, d tile, h tile, w tile): stage the input slab with its halo in on-chip memory, loop over IC; or implicit GEMM with K = IC*KD*KH*KW.

techniques.mechanism: for 3x3 stride-1 convs, F(2x2,3x3) Winograd cuts multiplies 2.25x
risks: numerical error grows with tile size (F(4x4,3x3) often fails 1e-3)

realizations.how: Transform 4x4 input tiles and the 3x3 filters (G g G^T), batched elementwise products over channels, inverse transform to 2x2 outputs.

techniques.mechanism: a grouped conv is G independent small GEMMs: batch them in one launch with per-group tiles

realizations.how: Grid over (group, M tile, N tile); each block runs an implicit-GEMM tile of its group (K = IC/G * KH * KW).

techniques.mechanism: many small GEMMs (bmm, per-head attention matrices): one block per matrix (or several per block) instead of tiling a single matrix

realizations.how: Grid over the batch (and tiles when matrices are large); for tiny matrices pack several per block and keep them entirely on chip.

techniques.mechanism: pick the loop order / tile load pattern for the operand that is transposed (matmul_ta / matmul_tb), so both operands load coalesced

realizations.how: Load the transposed operand's tile with threads along its contiguous dimension and transpose while storing into on-chip memory (pad to avoid bank conflicts).
